name: Cabaletta Bio, Inc.
summary: Cabaletta Bio, Inc., a clinical-stage biotechnology company, focuses on the discovery and development of engineered T cell therapies for patients with autoimmune diseases. The company's lead product candidate is resecabtagene autoleucel, a 4-1BB co-stimulatory domain-containing fully human CD19-CAR T, which is in Phase 1/2 clinical trials for the treatment of dermatomyositis, anti-synthetase syndrome, immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy, juvenile myositis, lupus nephritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, relapsing and progressive multiple sclerosis, mucocutaneous and mucosal pemphigus vulgaris (PV), systemic sclerosis, and generalized myasthenia gravis.
